name: Freki
title: Odin's Fury
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The Hounds of Odin, Freki and Geri, are a pair of fearsome wolves, often found at the All-Father’s side. They feast upon his leavings in Valhalla, and upon the fallen dead of Asgard’s battles. They also now serve as his fist and his wrath throughout Ryven, sent to rend and tear those who have angered their master beyond Asgard’s borders.
archetype_description: Increase all stats by 0.5% for each piece of chain armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: If the target is under 10 stacks of [Bleed], place [Barrier] on this hero equal to 30% of the damage inflicted.
Also, increase the damage inflicted by 3% for each stack of [Bleed] on the target.

skills.name: Sharp Fangs
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 15%HP+130%ATK with a 50% chance to place 3 stacks of [Bleed] on the target. If Geri is an ally, increase the chance to place [Bleed] by 25%. If Odin is an ally, activate [Bleed] after attacking.

skills.name: Feral Leap
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 20%HP+185%ATK with a 75% chance to place [Vulnerable II] on the target for 2 turns. If the target is under 5 stacks or more of [Bleed], also place [Curse II] on the target for 2 turns.

awakening_bonuses.description: If the target is under 10 stacks of Bleed, place Barrier on this hero equal to 30% of the damage inflicted.
awakening_bonuses.upgrade_description: If the target is under 10 stacks of [Bleed], place [Barrier] on this hero equal to 30% of the damage inflicted.

skills.name: Pack Retribution

skills.name: Chill of the Hunt
